title: UK Fiancé Visa Application | Unique Visa Services
description: Planning to marry in the UK? Get help with your fiancé or proposed civil partner visa from IAA-regulated advisers in Manchester.
intro: A fiancé or proposed civil partner visa lets you come to the UK to marry or form a civil partnership with your British or settled partner. After the wedding, you switch to a spouse visa without leaving the UK.
eligibility: You plan to marry or form a civil partnership within the visa period
You have met each other in person
You meet the financial and English language requirements
You can show your wedding plans are genuine
documents: Evidence of wedding plans, such as a booking or venue confirmation

faqs.q: Can I work on a fiancé visa?
faqs.a: No. You cannot work on a fiancé visa. You can work once you switch to a spouse visa after the wedding.
